records.issue_text: Feed polling job has no error handling and retry: false — a timeout, missing content, or nil link kills the job silently and the feed is never polled again, with one bad item aborting all subsequent items
records.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the scheduled job explicitly disables Sidekiq retries (`sidekiq_options retry: false`) and performs network + parsing work without any rescue (`rss = SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)`), then assumes item content is present (`i.content.scrub`). Any exception (timeout/open-uri failure, parse error, `i.content` being nil causing `NoMethodError` on `.scrub`) will abort the job run and stop processing remaining `rss.items`, so one bad fetch/item can prevent subsequent items from being imported in that execution.

records.issue_text: Non-atomic redis throttle (setnx followed by expire) in TopicRetriever can leave a retrieved:<url> key with no TTL, permanently locking out that embed URL
records.rationale:
In `lib/topic_retriever.rb` the throttle uses a non-atomic pattern:

```rb
if $redis.setnx(retrieved_key, "1")
  $redis.expire(retrieved_key, 60)
  return false
end
```

If the process crashes or is interrupted after `SETNX` succeeds but before `EXPIRE` runs, the `retrieved:<url>` key can be left without a TTL, causing `setnx` to fail forever and permanently throttling that embed URL. This behavior is directly implied by the diff.

records.issue_text: Client-side postMessage origin check uses indexOf substring match instead of prefix/URL-parse comparison, allowing spoofed origins to pass
records.rationale: In app/assets/javascripts/embed.js, the postMessage handler validates origin with a substring check: `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }`. This is not a strict origin comparison (scheme/host/port) and can be bypassed in cases where `discourseUrl` contains an attacker-controlled/alternate origin string as a substring or prefix (e.g., `discourseUrl` set to a longer host containing another host string). A proper comparison should parse `discourseUrl` and compare its `.origin` to `e.origin` for exact match.

records.issue_text: loading.html.erb reload loop has no failure signal — failed RetrieveTopic jobs cause the browser to reload every 30 seconds forever, re-enqueuing jobs unboundedly
records.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` is nil it unconditionally enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ..., embed_url: embed_url)` and renders `loading` (no backoff/limit). The `loading.html.erb` view then does `setTimeout(function() { document.location.reload(); }, 30000);`, so the browser will reload every 30s and trigger another enqueue each time. If `RetrieveTopic` never results in a `TopicEmbed` (e.g., failures, or `TopicRetriever#retrieve` skipping due to `invalid_host?`), the loop continues indefinitely and keeps enqueueing jobs.
